channel.title: Photos By Elie — California & USA Travel Photography
channel.description: Curated fine-art coastal and travel photography from San Diego, Del Mar, La Jolla, Solana Beach, and California by Elie Cohen.

item.title: Carlsbad, garden — Carlsbad Garden and Coast Light | Photos By Elie
item.description: A five-photo Photos By Elie edit of Carlsbad garden color, coastal dusk, and Southern California atmosphere, selected as travel photography and wall-art inspiration. Available as high-resolution fine-art wall prints and digital editorial licensing on Photos By Elie.

item.description: A Photos By Elie wildlife portrait edit from San Diego Zoo, selected for expressive animal detail, warm natural color, and wall-art potential. Available as high-resolution fine-art wall prints and digital editorial licensing on Photos By Elie.
